details: dir              Published site directory; default: public
--headed         Show the browser window
--trace          Save trace.zip; default output: system temporary directory
--out <dir>      Save JSON and screenshot in a new subdirectory
--timeout <ms>   Browser launch and individual action timeout; default: 15000
--page <path>    Article with an aside and overflowing reading content at 900 pixels high
--widths <list>  Comma-separated viewport widths; returns to the first width after resizing; default: 390,768,1800
--touch          Use a mobile touch context with native scrollbar colors
swban check/browser/canvas/scrollbar ./preview --page /article/
swban check/browser/canvas/scrollbar ./preview --page /article/ --touch --widths 390,768
dir              已完成的站点构建目录；默认：public
--headed         显示浏览器窗口
--trace          保存 trace.zip；默认输出到系统临时目录
--out <dir>      在新子目录保存 JSON 和截图
--timeout <ms>   浏览器启动和单次操作的超时，单位为毫秒；默认：15000
--page <path>    含侧栏且在 900 像素视口内需要滚动的文章
--widths <list>  视口宽度，用逗号分隔；调整后回到首个宽度；默认：390,768,1800
--touch          使用移动触摸环境和原生滚动条颜色
swban check/browser/canvas/scrollbar ./preview --page /article/
swban check/browser/canvas/scrollbar ./preview --page /article/ --touch --widths 390,768
